_note: Betting rules backed by backtests against closing lines. Edit these when weekly grading says so.

tz_spot.hit: 55% overall (129), 59% since 2021; 62% if kickoff 10pm ET or later (69)

nfl.side_note: no proven edge vs closing line; small-stake leans only, key numbers 3/7

betting._note: Which picks become bets and how $ are split. p = backtest hit rate vs closing line, n = games behind it.
betting._stake_method: fractional Kelly on a shrunk hit rate (p*n + 0.5*k)/(n + k), scaled so each day's stakes add to the budget

cfb_total_gap7.src: leave-one-season-out 2023-25 vs closing totals (2023 44.7%/94, 2024 52.9%/34, 2025 59.3%/54); was 60%/55 on 2025 alone

cfb_wind_under.src: published CFB wind studies (n discounted - not our data)

nfl_side_gap4.src: our 2025 NFL test (below threshold - lean only)

nfl_key_side.src: key-number cover probability (Normal around the closing line x historical margin frequencies), edge >= 1 pt over the price, walk-forward 2023-25 at actual closing odds: 35-22, +21% ROI; small sample

nfl_teaser_dog.src: 2-team 6-pt teaser, underdog legs +1.5/+2.5 with total <= 49: legs 395-109 (78.4%) 2012-26, each era 77-80%; teaser win = 0.784^2 at DK -120 (break-even 73.9% per leg)

nfl_teaser_leg.src: single teaser leg record (graded at the teased line); legs are paired into nfl_teaser_dog bets

cfb_total68_under.src: FBS vs FBS closing total 68+: under 261-193, 2015-25 (7 of 10 seasons profitable; higher totals stronger)

cfb_letdown.src: fade a team the week after it beat an Elo top-20% opponent: 272-208 2015-25 (50.7% in 2015-19, 59.1% in 2021-25) - half stakes

cfb_secb1g_road_bounce.src: SEC/Big Ten conference games: road team off a 21+ point loss or on a 3+ game losing streak, 127-85 2015-25 (53.4% 2015-19, 63.3% 2021-25) - half stakes

cfb_total_3star_under.src: previous model total 5-7 pts off the closing total, unders: 205-165 (55.4%) CFB 2016-25; added Oct 25 2026 from the star-tier backtest

cfb_total_3star_over.src: previous model total 5-7 pts off the closing total, overs: 341-308 (52.5%) CFB 2016-25

cfb_spread_3star.src: previous model 4-6 pts off the closing spread, side it likes: 499-475 (51.2%) CFB 2016-25; 130-98 (57.0%) in 2024-25

cfb_spread_4star_fade.src: fade the previous model when it is 6+ pts off the closing spread: 653-613 (51.6%) CFB 2016-25 (model side 48.4%)

betting.excluded: time-zone spots where the model disagrees; any game passed with --skip
betting._lean_note: lean_only rules are shown and graded on the report card but never become bets until their live record earns it
betting._kill_switch: After 50 live bets, retire any rule below 52.4% (teasers: legs below 73.9%). Leans are promoted after 50 live picks at 55%+.
